bio.text: Julie Willoughby, a Republican, represents District 13 in the Arizona House of Representatives, to which the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors appointed her on May 5, 2023; she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for the District 13 State Senate seat.
She is a registered nurse; Ballotpedia lists her career experience as including chief nursing officer of Exceptional Healthcare Inc. and trauma ER nurse with HonorHealth.

Willoughby graduated from Fountain Hills High School and, according to Ballotpedia, earned a B.S. in registered nursing from Arizona State University in 2012; her legislative biography also lists a Master of Science in Nursing.
